hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; the hook's main entry point is initializePools(), which delegates liquidity setup to an ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper. No swap logic is implemented.
